notes: Volume (11 pp.): index of the 24 agrupaciones departamentales with seats (pp.2-3, 132 seats), the statement (p.4) that the entities recognized under art. 14 a) of Ley 4763 (Partido Conservador, Partido Liberal Unificado, Partido Radical, Partido Demócrata, Confederación Republicana de Acción Cívica) presented exactly as many candidates as seats, so the Tribunal Calificador by sentence of 9 April 1930 proclaimed them without a vote (Protocolo II pp.41-46), and the proclaimed deputies by agrupación (pp.4-11). No votes, registered voters, election day or party affiliation of candidates are printed. Each contest has one pseudo-list 'Candidatos proclamados sin votación' with votes null and all candidates elected. No grouping held a vote in this volume.
